save_ocr_log_help: Disabled by default. When enabled, saves OCR input images and recognized text for debugging.
quick_loadout_enable_help: Equip preset souls and deploy the preset from the in-battle quick loadout panel; skips the legacy soul switch and battle preset, then applies the team-lock state from general battle settings
quick_loadout_mode_help: mode_number selects by group and preset number; mode_ocr selects by group and preset name
quick_loadout_group_number_help: Preset group number in the quick loadout panel
quick_loadout_preset_number_help: Preset number in the selected group
quick_loadout_group_name_help: Preset group name used in OCR mode
quick_loadout_preset_name_help: Preset name used in OCR mode
quick_loadout_custom_preset_enable_help: Select quick-loadout presets by stage name; deploy the preset and equip its souls once for each new boss challenge
quick_loadout_custom_preset_help: Format: boss_name:("group number or name","preset number or name"); separate entries with semicolons; ALL matches every monster not explicitly configured; OCR mode treats both values as names
guild_medal_donate_help: Donate jade guild medals once per day
account_order_help: Positions in the existing MultiAccountEvo account list, for example 1-18 or 1,3,5
enabled_accounts_help: Account positions participating on this instance; use 1 for the first single-account test
account_rotation_daily_task_enable_help: When enabled, every rotated account on this emulator runs the selected DailyTrifles tasks
daily_hunt_kirin_help: Run the short Kirin battle during account rotation
daily_hunt_netherworld_help: Run the short Netherworld Gate battle during account rotation
daily_cooperation_morning_help: Check jade and sushi cooperation during morning rotation
daily_cooperation_evening_help: Check jade and sushi cooperation during evening rotation
skip_completed_today_help: Do not switch accounts that were already verified successfully today
max_switch_attempts_help: Finite number of attempts for each account
switch_timeout_seconds_help: Total deadline for all attempts of one account
rotation_failure_policy_help: continue records a failure and moves on; stop ends the rotation immediately
multi_account_evo_role_help: Select one unique role on each instance: leader, member_1, or member_2
multi_account_evo_kirin_type_help: EvoZone material type shared by all three instances
multi_account_evo_layer_help: EvoZone layer shared by all three instances
group_count_help: Number of fixed three-account groups to run each day
ios_count_help: Number of iOS accounts at the start of the account list
battle_count_help: Number of EvoZone battles for each fixed group
sync_timeout_help: Maximum wait for peer READY, DONE, or group advancement
strict_platform_order_help: Require the first ios_count accounts to be iOS and the rest Android
related_account_help: Full oas3, oas4, and oas5 account mapping for the same fixed team
